signature_verification: Production installer verified each signed offline bundle before applying it.
limits: Version 1.2.9 is an unpublished candidate. These runs used a local HTTP mirror, generated bootstrap dependency procedure, and the signed offline installer; the final public GitHub one-command URL was not exercised.
Exact means a distinct signed OpenWrt version and package architecture target. CPU-family binaries may be byte-identical across different signed targets.
512 MiB RAM and a 512 MiB expanded ext4 disk were used. Minimum hardware memory, stock flash capacity, and individual physical routers were not qualified.
No personal subscription or external VPN endpoint was used. Menu, daemon lifecycle, Xray configuration validation, preservation of existing configuration, reboot, and uninstall were tested.

Previous separate public v1.2.8 LAN probes exercised synthetic IPv4 TCP/UDP/DNS with production firewall adapters; those probes are not a claim that all 17 final candidate targets completed real LAN forwarding.
